title: Dimension-free Markov--Bernstein inequalities for product measures
summary: For even integer exponents $p$, we obtain dimension-free Markov--Bernstein inequalities for polynomials with respect to product probability measures $μ=μ_1\otimes\cdots\otimesμ_n$. When the measures $μ_j$ have unimodal densities, we prove \[ \|\nabla f\|_{L^p(μ)} \le C(p) d^2 \|f\|_{L^p(μ)} \] for polynomials $f$ of degree at most $d$. The dependence on $d$ is optimal already for the uniform distribution on the unit cube.
